paras: The Tesla Model Y Power Frunk provides effortless convenience and storage with its electric lift-gate system. The frunk is an incredibly useful compartment for additional storage and is easily opened and closed with just a press of a button.
hl: Open the frunk using the app
Open and Close the frunk using the key fob (if you purchased a key fob)
Close the frunk with the factory emergency button
Open and Close the frunk with the center console touch screen
